## Instructions

1. Brown the onions in oil in a large pot.
2. Add the meat and brown, breaking it up.
3. Add green pepper, celery and garlic; cook 5 minutes.
4. Add the mushrooms.
5. Add tomatoes, soup, paste and seasonings.
6. Simmer 2 hours to 3 hours, stirring now and then.
7. Remove bay leaves before serving.
